candidate.title: SPY RSI(2) pullback in uptrend (Connors), intraday
candidate.one_line: Buy when RSI(2) drops below a threshold while price is above its one-session average; target, time and 0.5% stop exits. Source: Larry Connors and Cesar Alvarez (2008), Short Term Trading Strategies That Work.

sources.title: Larry Connors and Cesar Alvarez (2008), Short Term Trading Strategies That Work
sources.creator: Larry Connors; Cesar Alvarez
sources.claim: Buy when RSI(2) drops below a threshold while price is above its one-session average; target, time and 0.5% stop exits.

hypothesis.behavior: Very short-term oversold pullbacks inside an uptrend may revert upward within the session.
failure_theory: The daily-bar effect may not transfer to 1-minute bars.
Costs and next-bar fills may erase a published gross edge.

setup: SPY regular session 09:30-16:00 ET on 1m bars; signals use completed bars and fill at the next bar open.
long_entry: RSI(2) below threshold and close above the 390-bar (one session) SMA, 09:45-15:30.

exits.rule: Take profit, else exit after N bars; 0.5% stop.
exits.time_exit: Flat by 15:55 ET; no overnight position.

candidate_specific_checks: Evaluate only the predeclared grid; no expansion after seeing results.

exclusions: No paper/live trading or automatic promotion.
